event_name: Document 29 Date 26 May 2018 Time 16:23 2018 MONACO GRAND PRIX 23 - 27 May 2018 The Stewards have received a request from Aston Martin Red Bull Racing to allow car 33 to start the race despite not setting a time in qualifying. In accordance with Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards grant permission for car 33, Max Verstappen, to start the race as the driver has set satisfactory times in practice at this Event.
rules_referenced: Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: 2018 Monaco Grand Prix Decision Car 33 Failure To Set A Time In Qualifying29
